subject: Board advocate orchestration & deal rendezvous
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@omnidata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board advocate orchestration & deal rendezvous

Alicia —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) in place that aligns the executive sponsor seats at OmniData with our EB (executive briefing) cadence so we can lock the final purchase timeline.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm the two execs who will serve as primary sponsors (board/IT executive + procurement champion)
- Provide available 60–90 minute windows for an EB meeting in the week of June 7–14
- Any required compliance docs/procurement steps we should pre-populate in the MAP

I attached a first-pass MAP and a proposed exec roster template to make this fast. If you can share names and two possible EB slots, we'll finalize and send a calendar invite + DocuSign SOW for signature.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm sponsor names and one preferred EB slot by EOD Thursday (5/27)
2) We finalize MAP and share DocuSign (target signature by 6/1)
3) EB occurs, then we execute the dedicated capacity kickoff the following week

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps speed things up.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
attachments: RWI_MAP_omnidata_v1.pdf, Exec_Roster_omnidata.csv

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear plan and the templates. Quick answers:
- Primary exec sponsor: Priya Desai (CIO)
- Procurement champion: Daniel Hart (Head of Sourcing) — procurement looped above

Availability for an EB meeting (60–75m):
- Tue, June 8: 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed, June 9: 14:00–15:30 PT

Procurement notes: they want a high-level runbook of data residency and audit logging for our SOC2 readout before the EB; Daniel mentioned a standard redline to the SOW but is okay to receive your initial version.

I can confirm formally once Daniel signs off on the time.

Thanks,
Alicia

Alicia — thanks. Draft agenda and a revised MAP attached. I also uploaded an exec roster CSV with fields for title, emails, and preferred availability so we can slot people quickly.

Short EB draft agenda (60–75m):
- 0–10m: Welcome + objective (Priya & Marcus)
- 10–25m: Deployment model & data residency (Karthik + eng SME)
- 25–40m: Performance targets & cost expectations (Marcus)
- 40–55m: Procurement timeline & redline discussion (Daniel)
- 55–60m: Decision and next steps (all)

Attachments included: RWI_MAP_omnidata_v1.pdf (revised), Exec_Roster_omnidata.csv, DocuSign_SOW_20270526.pdf

Action items for Alicia/Daniel: pick the preferred EB slot from the two options above and confirm sponsor list in the roster CSV. Once confirmed we'll send the DocuSign link for the SOW and lock the calendar.

—Karthik

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Daniel confirmed Wed, June 9 at 14:00 PT for the EB and added a small request: can you include a short audit log sample and a one-page summary of our proposed retention controls in the packet? Procurement will need that before they approve the SOW redlines.
